description: This Java source file defines the CurrencyDomain class used in integration tests for the Apache Fineract project. It models currency data with fields like code, name, decimal places, and display labels, and includes JSON serialization/deserialization methods, a builder pattern, and comparison/hashcode implementations.

classes.name: CurrencyDomain
classes.description: A class representing currency information used in integration testing. Implements Comparable for sorting based on currency name, includes methods for JSON conversion, equality, and hash code.
